name: NGC 1651 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1651, a star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1651-hubble
story: A crowd of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. Hubble studied clusters like this one because their stars do not all seem to have aged in step, challenging the idea that a cluster's stars are born together.

claims.text: NGC 1651 is a globular cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way
NGC 1651 is a star cluster in the LMC that exhibits an extended main sequence turnoff
HST program 12257 targets NGC 1651 because multiple main-sequence turn-offs challenge the notion that star clusters are simple stellar populations
